notes.title: Utility Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/bf33b6a8e8358b1d24514855e70b40226705e60b.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hey Builders![/b][/h3]
This update brings new features related to user experience and user interface. Below are some of these features implemented, but there are more features that, as they are small details, are not worth highlighting, but check the changelog to find out more.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/f2548fff5d839fc3c461bef35d82689e78d5bd9e.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Categories[/b][/h2]
[b]Highly requested feature to group your workspaces[/b]

The entire sidebar has been redesigned to support this new feature.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/8cc7fbfa3712d15abbb647814c28a386087180c3.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Search Bar for Workspace[/b][/h2]
[b]Easier to stalk an item[/b]

Search for anything contained in any item in the current workspace.
A way to locate a selected item instantly has also been implemented.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/5eed017d9113bbf5c4905d530af94a02d3b1ab9e.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Better Tooltip[/b][/h2]
[b]For Inputs and Outputs[/b]

When hovering over any input or output of a block, a clearer and more user-friendly tooltip will be displayed to explain the port's usage.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/bb9ff0594964a2edde389d548cbb9077717d850a.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Dynamic Block[/b][/h2]
[b]Opening up new possibilities for Block Developers[/b]

Block Developers can now program the blocks to perform dynamic actions with limitless and unimaginable possibilities. Be aware that such capabilities may impact performance if used excessively.

For Block Developers: check out [url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Discord-Bot-Builder/Blocks/8cea95fafaf85aaed8f24c6ee70c9ab390b64134/templates/dynamic_block_test.js]dynamic_block_test.js[/url] to find out how to make a dynamic block.


[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Worth Mentioning[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Built-In Bot Terminal[/b], so the users don't need to install Node.js on their computers. This feature can be reversed in the app settings to use an external terminal.
[*] [b]Keybinds[/b], it's a new settings page to allow you to set up custom keyboard shortcuts for various actions.
[*] [b]Customizable Project Info[/b], it's now possible to rename projects and change their icons by right-clicking on them.
[*] [b]Lock/Unlock Items & Enable/Disable Blocks[/b], you can block Blocks from working or from changing their properties (moving, resizing, etc...).
[*] [b]Searchable Block Dropdowns[/b], when opening a dropdown menu from a block, the user can type to search for the menu option now.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Changelog[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Redesigned Workspaces Sidebar
[list]
[*]  Added Category to group workspaces
[*]  Added "Hide Disabled Workspaces" option
[*]  Workspace cards show their thumbnail as background
[*]  Workspace card icon can be clicked to toggle it on or off
[/list]
[*] Added Dynamic Block
[*] Improved Block Dropdowns ("SELECT" and "MULTISELECT")
[*] Added "aliases" property to Block
[*] Added "max" property to Block Multiport
[*] Added the ability to disable and lock workspace items
[*] The project can now be renamed and its icon changed too
[*] Added "Keybinds" settings page
[*] Added "External Bot Terminal" setting
[*] Removed "Maximize Block Size" setting
[*] Added "View" menu to top bar
[*] Added "Reload" menu option
[*] Improved tooltip for Block ports
[*] Added search bar to workspace
[*] Improved every search bar
[*] Made workspace item resizing respect "Snap Items to Grid" setting
[*] Note's title size no longer increases when zooming out
[*] Removed persistent "move" cursor icon from workspace editor
[*] Added Ukrainian language (incomplete)
[*] Improved CSS Selector, such as showing CSS Custom Properties and HTML Data Attributes
[*] Added "dbb://" custom protocol support for deep linking into DBB
[/list]



[i]MrGold - DBB Developer[/i]
[url=https://discord.gg/PAzxTDw style=button]DBB Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Bot Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/df2b25249eb7ecd5bedc40911b85bfc2998b40a5.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hey Builders![/b][/h3]
This is the first update related to the second phase of preview releases, where the new features are more about the bot this time. With that said, let's talk about the new DBB Bot v2.0:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/6fb174eddd53ca5c76fee05d29e4c541d88fccb4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]DBB Bot 2.0[/b][/h2]
The new [i]bot.js[/i] file was made from scratch to offer a better performance and fidelity, and is now smarter than ever at detecting issues and having new mechanics. Below there are some of those new features:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/09598f68beba9f45e21383e706350207c8cbe5b1.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]New Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[b]Less action, or not...[/b]

DBB Bot v2.0 is smart to the point of being able to get values from blocks that had no direct connection previously (via the [i]Action[/i] ports).
It's recommended that you continue connecting the blocks that may take longer to process and return the value (also known as asynchronous blocks), such as those that fetch data from the internet, read files, etc...
If you don't feel confident with this new logic, you can still continue connecting all the [i]Action[/i] ports as usual.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/4d165a08716f3641988da4cb836576f809839dfb.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Required Input Warning[/b][/h2]
[b]It happens to the best of us[/b]

In the console, it will warn you whenever it runs a block with a required input not connected, showing you all the information to help you find the target input.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/5bc661cc78a59d0129baece438eaabbdc9beefda.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]New Command/Interaction Blocks[/b][/h2]
[b]And more other blocks...[/b]

Finally added slash commands to DBB! [u]The old prefix command system is obsolete and it's recommended (even by Discord) to switch to slash commands or other types of commands/interactions.[/u]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/fd8b5f8a53aababe6ec1f18a7119ab78abf52697.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Multiselect Option[/b][/h2]
[b]Being able to select more than one option[/b]

This new option type provides the ability to get a list of selected options, ordered by the user, and the block developer can even set:
[list]
[*] [i]allowUserOptions = false[/i] - Whether to allow the user to write and select custom options
[*] [i]duplicates = false[/i] - Whether to allow the user to select the same option more than once
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/85953c028c9db8b8595adfde0875ea4d4ee92f1a.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Better Search[/b][/h2]
[b]Less scrolling and more accurate results at the top[/b]

Item Browser has a better algorithm to search for better overall results.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/b44be30eaf4d1f7b8b7abadf0a74a39bd2394dab.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Create Block by Dragging Wire[/b][/h2]
[b]Less wires to connect[/b]

Instead of always right-clicking to open the Item Browser, you can also drag a wire to an empty spot to open it and then wiring the newly placed block automatically.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Changelog[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added DBB Bot v2.0
[list]
[*] Slightly better overall performance
[*] Added new mechanics (see above)
[*] Added Required Input Warning
[*] Beautified console messages
[*] Added command/interaction-related blocks
[*] Fixed and improved audio-related blocks
[*] Added [i]executedFrom[/i] property to block's [i]cache[/i]
[*] Added new tools for block developers:
[list]
[*] [i]setDependency(dependencyId: string, blockName: string, data: unknown)[/i]
[*] [i]eraseConsole()[/i]
[*] [i]runNextBlock(outputId: string, cache: BlockCache, multiPortIndex?: number)[/i]
[*] [i]GetInputValueAsync(inputId: string, cache: BlockCache, explicitValue?: boolean, defaultValue?: unknown)[/i]
[*] [i]isInputConnected(inputId: string, cache: BlockCache, multiPortIndex?: number)[/i]
[*] [i]isOutputConnected(outputId: string, cache: BlockCache, multiPortIndex?: number)[/i]
[*] [i]findWorkspaces(searchType: "id" | "title" | "description", searchValue: string)[/i]
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Added [i]MULTISELECT[/i] and [i]TEXT_LINE[/i] option types for blocks
[*] Added the ability to add a description to each option in a [i]SELECT[/i] block option type
[*] Forced [i]bot.js[/i] file being updated on the first bot run
[*] Removed "Set Bot Main Prefix" and "Set Bot Owners" menu options as they are obsolete
[*] Improved "Set Bot Intents" menu option
[*] Updated "Generate Bot Invite" menu option to support a User-Installable App
[*] Added the ability to create items by dragging and dropping the wire into an empty spot
[*] Improved the search results of Item Browser

[*] Added "Animated Item Preview" and "Oversimplify Items" settings to [i]Workspace[/i] settings page

[*] Added Steam Language API support

notes.title: Redesign Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/aeccf1458d1643b0e39e817baa9897e3a1d0b595.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hey Builders![/b][/h3]
This update is about a substantial user interface change, the result of weeks of constant work and research. You will notice that there is a lot of work on the small details.
Initially, I thought I wouldn't need to make any more changes to the user interface for a while, but, in fact, there were many things to implement yet and more in the future.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/dd104907c15949a0f29b8691b6a386e7f28b8a6f.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]New Redesign[/b][/h2]
[b]A more intuitive, flexible and robust user interface[/b]

Now the user is less dependent on the application menu, making it easier to use and more versatile for adding new features, such as the new [i]App Settings[/i], located in the bottom left corner. There is more to discover...



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/123db6dda786471abe6b2568e1b773430cbe71ac.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Workspace Tabs & Multiproject[/b][/h2]
[b]Be more multitasking[/b]

Open more workspace and project in the same window and organize them however you want. You need to enable "Workspace Tabs" in the [i]App Settings[/i].



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/3da340bb8fee43713e8ab8df8cb1cbcf7d5ddbbd.gif[/img]
[h2][b]Workspace Edges[/b][/h2]
[b][strike][i]help me stepbro, i'm stuck[/i][/strike][/b]

Drag anything to the edges of the workspace window to move the workspace, making it more accessible.



[h3][b]Tips[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Press Ctrl+Tab to switch to the previous Workspace Tab
[*] Middle-click any Project, Block, Note, Wire, Workspace or Workspace Tab to delete it
[*] When dragging a new Wire, right-click over a port instead of releasing the left mouse button, to continue making more connections
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.0 Preview Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/fd8507a85dc97a3cd93ec9b6cce55ba582965ab2.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hey Builders![/b][/h3]
It took a while, but it's finally here the preview of the [strike]actual[/strike] 1.0.0 full release!
It's been almost 3 months of continuous development, from scratch, to present today a brand new user interface. The actual first concept of v1.0.0 was made more than a year ago, but i had to discard it, because i wasn't satisfied with the result and the design didn't follow Discord's style.
Also, I have to apologize for not having provided any new updates or even information lately. I have to make this sacrifice to stay focused on my personal problems.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/0488080f0ae139009435120386eb3ab45f92c2f8.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]New User Interface[/b][/h1]
[b]Inspired by some popular apps (besides Discord, of course)[/b]

The brand new user interface offers more agglomerated information, with a nicer experience and more animations.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/5e5180e16c493db1c9a25e938a2ca3eac4f54734.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Item Preview[/b][/h1]
[b]Easier to know which Block you are dealing with![/b]

When selecting the Block or Note to add, preview it by hovering the mouse over it, with a nice 3D animation.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/8b6c58eb6c276ea2ece885198995fcd8d426e00b.gif[/img]
[h1][b]Multiport Support [EXPERIMENTAL][/b][/h1]
[b]No more 50x Blocks please...[/b]

You will be able to list more ports as you wish, reducing Block limitations in the future.
This feature is still [b]experimental[/b], as it hasn't been implemented in all the Blocks that may need it and hasn't been fully tested.

[b]Update your bot.js file to support multiport feature![/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/3bab357b4512c4fcfdecbb2553ee1b332936f42a.gif[/img]
[h1][b]Multiselection Support[/b][/h1]
[b]Increase your productivity![/b]

Select as many Blocks and Notes as you want, by pressing [i]CTRL[/i], or select them all by clicking the button in the top left corner.
You can also resize Blocks and Notes in ALL directions now!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/fb0ee32d771f286cea68c99709713dde0c895cdb.gif[/img]
[h1][b]Better Workspace Customization[/b][/h1]
[b]Customize it to your liking.[/b]

It's even possible to copy/paste workspaces and turn them ON/OFF.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/93b27eb1e0a008d19078d2c77a767db05feae8d0.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Light Mode & Themes[/b][/h1]
[b]Flashbang![/b]

Light Mode for fans who like to burn their eyes out.
Additionally, you no longer need to change the original CSS file to add your favorite anime character...
[url=https://github.com/Discord-Bot-Builder/Themes]Check out the official DBB Community Themes repository![/url]

[b]Dev Tip:[/b] Go to Help -> Developer -> Show CSS Selector to find out which CSS selector to use in your CSS file. If you are having trouble applying your new styles, use [url=https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/important]!important[/url] flag.




[h2][b]Side Notes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added backup system.
[*] When creating a new project, you don't need to save it first.
[*] Added translations (only German, Portuguese, Russian and Swedish available at the moment). [url=https://github.com/Discord-Bot-Builder/Translations]Check out the official DBB Community Translations repository![/url] Thanks to [i]Artem's nite[/i], [i]MissDaily[/i], [i]NotCallMeHacker[/i] and [i]XCraftTM[/i]!

notes.title: Release Note for 1/03/2023
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] bot.js and blocks updated to Discord.js v14
[*] bot.js got an internal update
[*] New Audio Player blocks
[*] Added Bot Sharding support
[*] Fixed bugs
[/list]
Make sure to backup your current bot folder before updating it. There are some blocks that will probably break, especially the Audio Player ones.
If you need to get and use the old bot files, use the new branch called "previous-bot-version-djs12-deprecated" by going to Properties -> Betas on Steam.



[h2]Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Intents[/h3]
There is a new optional file (you can delete it and the bot will use the default value), called "INTENTS.txt", located in "data" folder, to change the Intents of your bot. You can use [url=https://discord-intents-calculator.vercel.app/]this calculator[/url] and copy and paste your Intents value in that file.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/8d9e28b37a78d37f827bd55b24a34ed405dc1f2a.png[/img]
Make sure your Privileged Intents are right at https://discord.com/developers/applications or your bot won't run. If you don't know what to select, leave all options selected, although it is a bad practice:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/0978d16bffff8d16d12d19d08f5cac593e80d77a.png[/img]


[h3]Sharding[/h3]
You can try to run your bot with Sharding by going to your new bot folder and run the "Start Sharding.bat" file. Make sure to have the "sharding.js" file in your bot folder:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/4ef5e622faf3b13a1fb16e8f5efb44cbeeacfebe.png[/img]



[b]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/PAzxTDw ]Discord server[/url] to get close support with the community.[/b]

[h3][b]Hey Builders![/b][/h3]
First of all, thank you for the patience of waiting for a new beginning of Discord Bot Builder. This year did not start well, as you all know, making delays and unforeseen events, as well delaying the development of my projects. I expected to have the stable version on August 1, the date the program celebrated its 1st anniversary, but it was not possible in a short space of time and the blocks update was not even finished.
Anyway, today I present you the new version 0.1.0. For everyone who was using the standard version, it is no longer possible to use it again, as it has been discontinued, in favor of the new version that was being developed in the "beta" branch.

notes.title: Blocks Update and Other Things (1.0.0-beta)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/e08b169bc1a839e1976dc4010b5c171ea1320aa8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hey Builders![/b][/h1]
Before starting, thank you for waiting all this time for a new update, I have been working hard on this update all this time and now I can finally show you what I was hiding. I recommend you to read [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1119570/announcements/detail/2665493825327868920]this post[/url]. Trust me, it was worth the wait. Let's start!


[b]NOTE:[/b] For now, this update is for Discord Bot Builder Beta only. If you don't know what it is or how to install it, check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1119570/announcements/detail/1601512606953020169]this post[/url].


[h1]About Blocks[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/8090942825916704ae5cf63a8f215b83bd5d0d3f.gif[/img]
[b]Create Workspaces[/b]
This is where you can organize your workspaces. The workspaces are where you insert your blocks and notes. I recommend that you not only create a single workspace but more because too many blocks and notes in a single workspace can crash your PC or get confusing for you. All workspaces will be executed by your bot, don't worry.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/4e2c63a9a852023d10dd1c5ebda3a532d34fb7fc.gif[/img]
[b]Create Blocks and Notes[/b]
This is where everything begins. Right click and select what you want. Blocks are responsible for the functionality of your bot. Notes are elements whose purpose is to organize your workspace.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/03632aba078ffcfe98082b69e22a123d64b9a9cf.gif[/img]
[b]Connect Blocks[/b]
Basically all you need to do is connect the blocks to make your bot working. Respect the acceptable connector types, wrong types can be rejected by it. Requires training but you can get it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/964f56ef34f71b03df49fe40eafae828c2b5a53e.gif[/img]
[b]Zoom your Workspace[/b]
Use your mouse wheel to zoom your workspace. Sometimes is good in order to taking a good picture of your work.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/faec820e39138696ae4790224856d723f33d3df2.gif[/img]
[b]Make Art[/b]
Color your blocks and notes for a better viewing experience. Make your world colorful and not just black and white.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/15daf7373f087c6a439bc9f1becce3cf45e9db74.gif[/img]
[b]Resize Them[/b]
Resize your blocks and notes. Sometimes some blocks and notes are too large or small. Find a perfect balance.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/85c84584dd833e954612240876828f119b176749.gif[/img]
[b]Blocks Help You[/b]
Yes, blocks are helpful. Just move your mouse to a block and wait for a popup message to appear to you. (If any block has a bad description, judge me)


[h1]About Templates[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/f0d896e3ab1470871cc259f526788cbce493536f.gif[/img]
[b]Categories for Features[/b]
Everything separated for better organization.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/1f6d470993d7d6193cd7d12cfff4e7334a12e621.png[/img]
[b]New Feature[/b]
Yes i know, i only added one feature because i was more focused on Blocks than Templates... 


[h1]About Other Things[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/8ddb49313815f4e319b05e24c703297a07c5cbfb.gif[/img]
[b]Menu Bar Updated[/b]
Added keyboard shortcuts and new options.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35455752/da6cdce17e7e2f283d111bfcac8a02e092dabf1a.gif[/img]
[b]Better Discord Rich Presence[/b]
Now everyone can see what you are doing more accurately.



Thanks to everyone who supports me in this project. Haters please go away...
